questionText: A STUDENTS table has SID, SNAME and a COURSES table has CID, CNAME, SID (foreign key). Write a query to display SNAME and CNAME for all students who are enrolled in a course.
explanation: INNER JOIN returns rows where there is a matching value in both tables. Students with no course will not appear in the result.

questionText: From the same STUDENTS and COURSES tables, write a query to display all students including those not enrolled in any course.
explanation: LEFT JOIN returns all rows from the left table (STUDENTS) and matching rows from the right table (COURSES). Unmatched students appear with NULL for CNAME.

questionText: Explain Cartesian Product / CROSS JOIN with an example query using STUDENTS and COURSES tables.
explanation: CROSS JOIN (Cartesian Product) joins every row of the first table with every row of the second table. If STUDENTS has 5 rows and COURSES has 4 rows, the result has 5 × 4 = 20 rows.
